elements.label: section_header
elements.text: HOW YOUR DISHWASHER CLEANS

elements.label: text
elements.text: Your dishwasher cleans by spraying a mixture of hot water and detergent through the spray arms against soiled surfaces.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The dishw asher fills with w ater cov ering the filt er area. Water is then pumped thr ough the multiple filt ers and spray arms. Soil particles are separated from the water and go down the drain as the water is pumped out and replaced with clean water.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The number of wat er fills will v ary depending on the cycle selected.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Auto C ycle uses sensors in the dishwasher to determine the soil level of the dish load, and then adjusts the wash cycle to optimize wash performance, water and energy usage.

elements.label: text

elements.text: Normal C ycle with only the Auto Open option selected is recommended to completely wash and dry a full load of normally soiled dishes. The energy usage label is based on this cycle and option combination.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: QUICK

elements.label: text
elements.text: Quick Cycle is for lightly soiled or well-rinsed dish loads.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: MY WASH

elements.label: text
elements.text: My Wash allows you to create a custom cycle on the SmartHome App that can be saved and loaded on to your dishwasher so that your favorite or specialty cycle can be right at your fingertips. The default MY WASH cycle is a NORMAL cycle with AUTO OPEN and EXTENDED DRY options selected.

elements.label: text
elements.text: To change My Wash, open the app and once connected, click on the more button next to cycles on the dishwasher status page. Click on My Wash and select Settings. You can now edit My Wash to set the cycle, options, and times you prefer.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Click Upload when complete, and the cycle will be saved in the app and uploaded to the My Wash button on your dishwasher.

elements.label: text
elements.text: For more information, please refer to 'My Wash Setup and use' on Page 33.

elements.label: text
elements.text: WARNING: Only sanitizing cycles have been designed to meet the requirements for soil removal and sanitiza tion efficac y. There is no intention, either directly or indirectly, that all cycles on a c ertified machine have passed the sanitization performance test.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The Sanitize option sanitizes dishes and glassware in accordance with NSF International NSF/ANSI Standard 184 for Residential Dishwashers. C ertified r esidential dishwashers are not intended for use in licensed food establishments.

elements.label: text
elements.text: When the Sanitize option is selected, the water temperature will reach 15 8 °F ( 70 °C) maximum.

elements.label: text
elements.text: Sanitize Control illuminates to indicate when the wash cycle with the Sanitize option is completed. The light will turn off 60 seconds after the door is manually opened or when any button is pressed.

elements.label: text
elements.text: NOTE: If the temperature of the incoming hot water does not meet the minimum requirement of 120°F(49°C), it is possible that the water will not reach 158°F (70°C) in Sanitize mode.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: HI TEMP WASH

elements.label: text
elements.text: The H i Temp Wah option increases the main wash temperature to enhance cleaning performance for loads with tough, baked-on food.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: AUTO OPEN

elements.label: text
elements.text: When the Auto Open option is selected, the door of your dishwasher will open at the end of the wash or wash/dry cycle to allow the hot, without use of additional energy. humid air to escape from the unit and accelerate the drying of dishes

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: EXTENDED DRY

elements.label: text
elements.text: When the Extended Dry option is selected, the heating time will be extended to improve drying performance during the drying process.

elements.label: text
elements.text: NOTE: For optimal drying performance, select both EXTENDED DRY and AUTO OPEN. For even better results, use with rinse aid. Extended Dry is not recommended for daily use.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: STRAWash

elements.label: text
elements.text: When the STRAWash option is selected, dedicated straw washing jets will be turned on during the cycle. This option dedicates additional time and wash action to the STRAWash feature, allowing for additional cleaning of straws.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: PREPARE DISHES

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Empty liquids from glasses and cups.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Remove leftover food, bones, toothpicks and other hard items from the dishes and discard.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: It is not necessary to hand-rinse dishes before loading them into the dishwasher with the following exceptions:

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Foods such as mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, lemon juice and tomato - based products may discolor stainless steel and plastics if allowed to remain on them for any length of time.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Burnt-on foods should be loosened before loading cookware into the dishwasher.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: LOAD DISHES

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: It is IMPORTANT for the water spray to reach all soiled surfaces.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: If possible, load dishes so they are not stacked or overlapping. For best drying results, water must be able to drain from all surfaces.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Load heavy pots and pans carefully. Heavy items can dent the stainless steel interior of the door if they are dropped or bumped.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Make sure pot lids and handles, pizza pans, cookie sheets, or other tall items do not interfere with the spray arm rotation.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Make sure both the upper and lower spray arms are not blocked and can move freely.

elements.label: list_item

elements.label: list_item

elements.label: list_item

elements.label: text
elements.text: Using this feature, you can monitor and control the dishwasher remotely through a wireless connection.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: Remote Control Levels and Settings

elements.label: text
elements.text: The remote control feature has three levels: Off, One Time, and Permanent. These can only be adjusted through the app.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Off: When set to Off in the app, you can only check the device status. Remote operation is disabled. The Smart Control indicator will be off.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: One Time: When One Time is selected, pressing the Smart Control button will turn on the indicator light, enabling remote control. However, remote control will be disabled if the door is opened or powered down . To reactivate, press the Smart Control button and close the door.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Permanent: When Permanent is selected, the Smart Control indicator will flash for 15 minutes. Within this time, press the permanently enable remote control without needing to press the button again for Smart Control button on the dishwasher to future operations.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: Commissioning and Using Permanent Remote Start

elements.label: text
elements.text: By setting Permanent Remote Control, you can always control the device remotely through the app, and once the Permanent Remote Start is enabled, you won't need to press the Smart Control button again unless you decide to deactivate it. The Remote Start feature allows you to start a cycle from anywhere as long as the door is shut and the feature is enabled.

elements.label: text
elements.text: To enable remote control permanently,

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Connect the unit to the app.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: In the app, navigate to the Smart Control page.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Select and enable Permanent Remote Start in the app.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Once Permanent Remote Start is enabled, press the Smart Control button on the unit within 15 minutes of enabling.

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Permanent Remote Start is now active until turned off.

elements.label: text
elements.text: To use My Wash ,

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Click on the More button next to Cycles on the dishwasher status page.

elements.label: list_item

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Click start when complete, and the cycle will be saved in the app and uploaded to the My Wash button on your dishwasher.

elements.label: text

Test kits are available from all major appliance parts retail outlets. If your water has a hardness over 8 grains per gallon, you may consider installing a water softener or regularly use an additive to enhance the performance of your detergent.

elements.label: section_header
elements.text: DRAIN AIR GAP

elements.label: text
elements.text: Check the drain air gap anytime your dishwasher isn't draining well. Some state or local plumbing codes require the addition of a drain air gap between a built-in dishwasher and the home drain system. If a drain is clogged, a drain air gap prevents water from backing up into the dishwasher.

elements.label: text
elements.text: The drain air gap is usually located on top of the sink or countertop near the dishwasher.

elements.label: text
elements.text: NOTE: The drain air gap is an external plumbing device that is not part of your dishwasher. The warranty provided with your dishwasher does not cover service costs directly associated with the cleaning or repair of the external drain air gap.

elements.label: section_header

elements.text: WINTERIZING YOUR DISHWASHER

elements.label: text
elements.text: Protect your dishwasher and home against water damage caused by freezing water lines. If your dishwasher is left in a seasonal dwelling or could be exposed to near freezing temperatures, have your dishwasher winterized by authorized service personnel.

elements.label: list_item

elements.label: list_item
elements.text: Place a pan under the inlet valve, and then disconnect the water line from the inlet valve.

elements.label: list_item
